concerns.text: T004 requires the CSV to 'match contracts/dataset.schema.yaml' AND spec Section 4 columns, but the read-only schema uses lines_of_code/is_bug_fix/code_unit_id/split and omits function_name, start_line, end_line, bug_label — the two are unsatisfiable simultaneously. No task corrects dataset.schema.yaml itself (T001 only fixes data-model.md). Add a task to reconcile the schema with spec Section 4 or drop the schema-match requirement from T004.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all phases) vs plan.md:Complexity Tracking 'Mixed-Effects Model'
concerns.text: The plan commits to a Mixed-Effects model via pymer4 ('mixed-effects required for valid inference', methodology-a5c0e953) and lists pymer4 as a primary dependency, but no task trains, evaluates, or explicitly descopes a mixed-effects model. Either add a task or record the descoping decision.

Spec Section 5.4 lists 'Calibration plots' as an evaluation metric; T009 computes only a Brier score (calibration_error). No task produces a calibration plot artifact. Add a calibration-plot deliverable to T009 or an equivalent task.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 vs plan.md:Data Flow step 1 / Project Structure / Constitution Check
concerns.text: T002 replaces GHTorrent with direct git clones, but the plan's Data Flow ('Download GHTorrent archives'), Project Structure comment, and Constitution Check row still mandate GHTorrent — a plan element with no task that implements it as written and no task updating the plan. The tasks doc's re-plan note does not amend plan.md; add a task to update plan.md (and spec Section 3) to the verified clone-based source.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all) vs plan.md:Project Structure 'requirements.txt' and constitution Reproducibility Requirements
concerns.text: The constitution requires a pinned requirements.txt at code/ and the plan lists it in the project structure, but no task creates or pins requirements.txt (including the pinned lizard version, Principle VI). Add it to T001/T002 or a setup task.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005 vs spec.md:Risk Management 'fallback to manual review'
concerns.text: Spec's low-precision mitigation includes 'fallback to manual review if needed', but T005 only fails the pipeline when precision < 85%; no task defines or documents the fallback path. Minor coverage gap on a spec mitigation clause.
